what: Interactive browser checks against a running installation with both example extensions, T20, T21 and T22
how: The extension host was served by the development image over plain HTTP, with both packages installed and their assets published, and driven in a browser.

T21 drawer and mounting.opening a ticket in the drawer: all five widgets present, in registered order
T21 drawer and mounting.create mode: no contributed widget is rendered, because both are registered for detail only
T21 drawer and mounting.reopening the same ticket: exactly one widget node and one added control; no duplicate listeners

dispose on drawer close.why: The preview browser is WebKit and does not fire the <dialog> close event at all here, so neither the application's own close cleanup nor the dispose hook runs in it. The equivalent guarantee was checked instead: reopening mounts exactly once, and a fragment refresh replaces a widget without leaving a second mount behind.

T22 auto-save of a contributed field.editor: the existing inline editor, with data-auto-save

T20 upload through the extracted widget.upload: started on selection, list refreshed through the shared fragment path
T20 upload through the extracted widget.a .php upload: refused with the existing message; the list still holds only the one legitimate file
